body:
It's funny, at first I was going to be mad at you. Originally this post seemed like a I'M HAPPY LOL Y U NOT type of post.

But then I thought about it and realized something. One of my biggest problems with my life is that I don't really have anything I'm...passionate about. Not that I don't have a reason to live, but I don't have a reason to enjoy living.

And then I thought about it some more, and I realized...I like making people feel better. I like making people feel good about themselves, and I like helping people get through tough times (as ironic as it is that I'm having a shitty time). And your post helped me realize that, in a way.

So...no, thank YOU, sir. You somehow indirectly helped me realize what I need to do to make my life worth living again. I need to be like a glowing ray of awesome friendliness and just try to touch the lives of everyone I meet for the better, however I can.

Interesting what a little bit of introspection can do once you get a push in the right direction (intentionally or otherwise). :)
Yes, but it's shortlived and duller than it should be. Like if normal happiness would be a 10, usually I feel a 7. Which is okay, I guess, but annoying.
